title: Switching a 3-range column to % Off counts 1 change, then 4
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, three ranges, tier A on Markup % with 5, 6 and 7.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Pick % Off in tier A's rule picker.
  5. Type 10 in tier A's first range.
  6. Type 12 in tier A's second range.
  7. Type 15 in tier A's last range.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens in view, tier A showing Markup % with 5, 6 and 7.

Step 3:

  • The edit bar reads "No changes yet", with Cancel and Save.

Step 4:

  • All three of tier A's ranges switch to % Off and are empty.
  • The edit bar reads "1 change".

Step 5:

  • Tier A's first range reads 10.

Step 6:

  • Tier A's second range reads 12.

Step 7:

  • Tier A's last range reads 15.
  • The edit bar reads "4 changes": 1 for the rule type and 1 for each of the 3 ranges (1 + 3 = 4).
